title: CIMA UK – Chartered Institute of Management Accountants
subtitle: Build a Global Career in Management Accounting, Finance and Business Strategy

runs.text: The CIMA UK qualification, offered by the Chartered Institute of Management Accountants, is a globally recognised professional pathway for individuals aspiring to build careers in management accounting, financial management, business performance and strategic decision-making.

intro.text: The CIMA UK qualification, offered by the Chartered Institute of Management Accountants, is a globally recognised professional pathway for individuals aspiring to build careers in management accounting, financial management, business performance and strategic decision-making.

runs.text: Through the CGMA (Chartered Global Management Accountant) Professional Qualification, students develop the skills to analyse financial information, manage business risks, improve organisational performance and support strategic business decisions.

intro.text: Through the CGMA (Chartered Global Management Accountant) Professional Qualification, students develop the skills to analyse financial information, manage business risks, improve organisational performance and support strategic business decisions.

runs.text: CIMA combines accounting, finance, management and business strategy, making it an excellent choice for students and professionals who want to progress beyond traditional accounting roles.

intro.text: CIMA combines accounting, finance, management and business strategy, making it an excellent choice for students and professionals who want to progress beyond traditional accounting roles.

runs.text: Global Recognition: The CGMA qualification is recognised internationally and supports career opportunities across a wide range of industries.

content.text: Global Recognition: The CGMA qualification is recognised internationally and supports career opportunities across a wide range of industries.

runs.text: Business-Focused Learning: Develop expertise in management accounting, financial reporting, business performance and strategic planning.

content.text: Business-Focused Learning: Develop expertise in management accounting, financial reporting, business performance and strategic planning.

runs.text: Career Advancement: Build the knowledge and skills needed for finance leadership, business partnering and management roles.

content.text: Career Advancement: Build the knowledge and skills needed for finance leadership, business partnering and management roles.

runs.text: Practical Application: Learn to apply financial information and business analysis to real-world organisational challenges.

content.text: Practical Application: Learn to apply financial information and business analysis to real-world organisational challenges.

runs.text: Flexible Study Options: Choose a suitable learning pathway, including tuition-provider learning, self-study or the CGMA Finance Leadership Program (FLP).

content.text: Flexible Study Options: Choose a suitable learning pathway, including tuition-provider learning, self-study or the CGMA Finance Leadership Program (FLP).

runs.text: Multiple Entry Routes: Graduates and experienced professionals may qualify for exemptions or entry at a higher level, depending on their previous qualifications and experience.

content.text: Multiple Entry Routes: Graduates and experienced professionals may qualify for exemptions or entry at a higher level, depending on their previous qualifications and experience.

runs.text: The CGMA Professional Qualification consists of three progressive levels: Operational, Management and Strategic. Each level covers three subject areas and a Case Study Examination.

content.text: The CGMA Professional Qualification consists of three progressive levels: Operational, Management and Strategic. Each level covers three subject areas and a Case Study Examination.

runs.text: 1. Operational Level

content.text: 1. Operational Level

runs.text: Focuses on short-term decision-making and implementing business plans.

content.text: Focuses on short-term decision-making and implementing business plans.

runs.text: E1 – Managing Finance in a Digital World: Understand the role of finance in organisations and the impact of digital technology.

content.text: E1 – Managing Finance in a Digital World: Understand the role of finance in organisations and the impact of digital technology.

runs.text: P1 – Management Accounting: Learn costing, budgeting, planning and performance management.

content.text: P1 – Management Accounting: Learn costing, budgeting, planning and performance management.

runs.text: F1 – Financial Reporting: Understand financial accounting, reporting principles and financial statements.

content.text: F1 – Financial Reporting: Understand financial accounting, reporting principles and financial statements.

content.text: Award on completion: CIMA Diploma in Management Accounting.

runs.text: 2. Management Level

content.text: 2. Management Level

runs.text: Focuses on medium-term planning, resource allocation and managing business performance.

content.text: Focuses on medium-term planning, resource allocation and managing business performance.

runs.text: E2 – Managing Performance: Learn how to manage organisational performance and implement business plans.

content.text: E2 – Managing Performance: Learn how to manage organisational performance and implement business plans.

runs.text: P2 – Advanced Management Accounting: Develop skills in advanced costing, budgeting, decision analysis and risk management.

content.text: P2 – Advanced Management Accounting: Develop skills in advanced costing, budgeting, decision analysis and risk management.

runs.text: F2 – Advanced Financial Reporting: Study advanced financial reporting, group accounts and relevant accounting standards.

content.text: F2 – Advanced Financial Reporting: Study advanced financial reporting, group accounts and relevant accounting standards.

runs.text: Award on completion: CIMA Advanced Diploma in Management Accounting.

content.text: Award on completion: CIMA Advanced Diploma in Management Accounting.

runs.text: 3. Strategic Level

content.text: 3. Strategic Level

runs.text: Focuses on long-term business strategy, financial leadership and strategic decision-making.

content.text: Focuses on long-term business strategy, financial leadership and strategic decision-making.

runs.text: E3 – Strategic Management: Understand business strategy, competitive positioning and strategic implementation.

content.text: E3 – Strategic Management: Understand business strategy, competitive positioning and strategic implementation.

runs.text: P3 – Risk Management: Learn to identify, evaluate and manage business risks.

content.text: P3 – Risk Management: Learn to identify, evaluate and manage business risks.

runs.text: F3 – Financial Strategy: Study investment decisions, business valuation, financing and financial risk.

content.text: F3 – Financial Strategy: Study investment decisions, business valuation, financing and financial risk.

runs.text: Final assessment: Strategic Case Study Examination.

content.text: Final assessment: Strategic Case Study Examination.

runs.text: Successful completion of the professional assessments, together with the required practical experience and membership requirements, leads to the CGMA qualification and the relevant CIMA membership designation.
